candidate: CloudHQ Project Asahi Technology Campus (BIG HOP Garden Mall Inzai redevelopment), Inzai Makinohara, Chiba
decision: Selected the planar centroid of Ministry of Justice registry-map lot 原一丁目2-1 (Inzai City), the BIG HOP Garden Mall Inzai parent property on which CloudHQ's Project Asahi plan places two data-centre blocks, as a campus_locator. The point locates the parent property only, not either planned data-centre building.
coordinate_reference_system: CRS84 longitude/latitude as published by AIGID in the GeoJSON conversion of the MOJ registry-map data (source coordinate system 公共座標9系, JGD2011 Japan Plane Rectangular CS IX per the AIGID dataset). The centroid was computed in the published lon/lat plane; recomputing it in EPSG:6677 and transforming back gives the same six-decimal point (0.0 m offset).
capture_custody_note: A first capture with the standard 45 s capture script timed out (moj-12231-2026.geojson.metadata.json records the failure; nothing was written). One further request was made with the otherwise identical 600 s timeout variant used by the 2026-10-17 japan_east lane, under a new file name; no other retry. The file's internal collection name ends _2025 although it is the 2026 catalog resource (catalog last updated 2026-08-10).
identity_chain: BIG HOP Garden Mall Inzai's own access page (bighop-access.html, sha256 709fe613...) gives the mall's address as 〒270-1335 千葉県印西市原1-2.

The 2026 MOJ/AIGID registry data for Inzai holds three lots under 原一丁目 2番: 2-1 (H000007100, 133,187 m2), 2-2 (H000006792, 23,038 m2) and 2-3 (H000007101, 956 m2). Lots 2-2 and 2-3 lie together in the south-west corner (bounds 140.1593-140.1614 E, 35.8012-35.8028 N).

GSI's address search returns 千葉県印西市原一丁目２番地 at 140.164886, 35.803074, which falls inside lot 2-1 (183 m from the selected centroid); GSI places 印西牧の原駅 at 140.166716, 35.803497, 354 m east of the centroid, matching the mall's position beside the station.

Inzai City's 29 September 2026 council briefing (sisakusei.pdf, page 16) outlines the BIG HOP block west of 印西牧の原駅 with a separately boxed '既存DC' in its south-west corner; CloudHQ's Project Asahi site plan (zigyousya.pdf, page 31) shows the same arrangement: railway to the north, Inzai Makinohara Station to the east, 'EXISTING DCs' in the south-west corner, and two new 'DC' blocks in the south-centre of the redeveloped site.

Qualitative imagery check only: overlaying lots 2-1, 2-2 and 2-3 on twelve GSI seamless aerial photo tiles (z17, x116565-116568, y51557-51559; capture date not stated by GSI) puts the BIG HOP mall building (roof lettering visible) and its surface car parks inside lot 2-1 and a separate cleared or parking plot inside lot 2-2, consistent with the south-west 'existing DC' plot of the two plans. This is not a measured accuracy.

South-west plot shown as existing data centres in both the city map and the CloudHQ plan; not part of the new Project Asahi data-centre blocks.

precision_statement: Centroid of the roughly 13.3 ha BIG HOP parent parcel. The two planned data-centre blocks occupy an unmeasured part of it (south-centre on the plan); the point is not a building footprint, phase boundary, entrance or construction extent. Six decimals are calculation precision, not accuracy.
